# agentsfleet — Fleet Delivery Control Plane

## Machine-readable API surfaces
- OpenAPI spec: /openapi.json
- agentsfleet manifest: /agentsfleet-manifest.json (JSON Linked Data)
- Health/status: /heartbeat
- Documentation: /docs

## API base
https://agentsfleet.net/v1

## Operations (operationId: method path)
Status transitions ride PATCH on the fleet resource — body {status: "active"|"stopped"|"killed"}.
"paused" is a platform-only state set by the anomaly gate; not callable from the API.
- create_fleet:        POST   /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fleets     # body: {source, name, review_digest, start} — saves a reviewed draft
- patch_fleet:         PATCH  /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fleets/{fleet_id}     # body: {name?, status?}
                       #   status "stopped" — halt session, resumable
                       #   status "active"  — resume from stopped/paused
                       #   status "killed"  — terminal mark (irreversible)
- apply_fleet_revision: POST  /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fleets/{fleet_id}/revisions   # apply a reviewed setup improvement
- delete_fleet:        DELETE /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fleets/{fleet_id}     # hard-purge; precondition status='killed'
- post_fleet_message:  POST   /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fleets/{fleet_id}/messages   # steer / chat
- list_fleet_events:   GET    /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fleets/{fleet_id}/events
- stream_fleet_events: GET    /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fleets/{fleet_id}/events/stream
- ingest_connector_webhook: POST /v1/ingress/{provider}
- ingest_qstash_schedule: POST /v1/ingress/qstash/schedules
- receive_source_webhook: POST /v1/webhooks/{fleet_id}/{source}   # the URL Save returns per webhook trigger
- get_tenant_billing:         GET /v1/tenants/me/billing
- get_tenant_billing_charges: GET /v1/tenants/me/billing/charges
- get_model_library:      GET /v1/models    # paged; ?limit=&starting_after=&q=&provider= — ETag/If-None-Match
- list_tenant_model_entries: GET /v1/tenants/me/models   # paged; the tenant's own model registry
- list_workspace_libraries:     GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fleet-libraries   # paged gallery: platform catalog ∪ this workspace's entries

Every list above is a bounded keyset page: read `next_cursor` and follow it.
A client that reads only the first page silently loses everything past it.

## Authentication
Bearer token: Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
The QStash schedule ingress uses QStash delivery signatures instead of a bearer token.

## Execution model
A Fleet is a long-lived, event-driven autonomous worker scoped to a workspace.
Events reach it from its triggers (signed webhooks at
`POST /v1/webhooks/{fleet_id}/{source}`, Svix-signed ones at
`POST /v1/webhooks/svix/{fleet_id}`, schedules and chat mentions) and from
steer messages, and each is appended to the Fleet's event stream. The control plane
(`agentsfleetd`) assigns each event to a host-resident `agentsfleet-runner` via a lease;
the runner runs the Fleet's loop, which can call tools, update state,
and emit further events. Operators steer or kill running Fleets through the
control-plane endpoints above.
